answer: Proof of Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By requiring agents to lock capital, the system ensures that influence scales linearly with economic investment rather than identity creation. A plume of malicious nodes attempting to inflate their presence finds the jade barrier of capital costs prohibitive. An attacker must sustain a constant pulse of financial outflow to secure voting weight, making the generation of fake identities economically irrational compared to the yield of honest participation.
